messages.subject: Multiple group analysis
parts:
I am comparing CFAs across 17 groups. I am finding the HTMLSummaryTable command very useful for comparing summary statistics across these 17 groups. Is there a way to create a similar table but for the parameter estimates? I do see such a table becoming quite complicated with multiple factors, but I happen to be dealing with a one factor model.

Thank you,
Tait

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Multiple group analysis
parts:
Hi Tait,

Because parameter estimates vary so much in their contents, we haven't developed a function for presenting these. But I would encourage you to look at the xtable package (e.g., http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/xtable/vignettes/xtableGallery.pdf), which is very capable of making custom tables in LaTeX and HTML. HTML can often be pasted directly into MS programs like Excel, whereas the LaTeX can be formatted easily into PDFs using tools like TexShop.


library(xtable)
m <- readModels("myModel.out")
print(xtable(m$unstandardized), type="html")

Hope that helps,
Michael
